{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 10], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "6807742980271641102", "path": "C:/思源粗宋.ttf"}}], "text": "绘本网站已经可以接入"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 14], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "6807742980271641102", "path": "C:/思源粗宋.ttf"}}], "text": "WorkBuddy 这个平台"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 11], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "6807742980271641102", "path": "C:/思源粗宋.ttf"}}], "text": "我们打开我们的网站首页"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 16], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "6807742980271641102", "path": "C:/思源粗宋.ttf"}}], "text": "上面能看到我们有一个连接器的配置"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 33], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "6807742980271641102", "path": "C:/思源粗宋.ttf"}}], "text": "点开以后你把它 copy 下来，然后打开我们的 WorkBuddy"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 15], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "6807742980271641102", "path": "C:/思源粗宋.ttf"}}], "text": "你告诉他帮我安装一下这个连接器"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 15], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "6807742980271641102", "path": "C:/思源粗宋.ttf"}}], "text": "丢给他，他就开始安装，稍等一下"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 10], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "6807742980271641102", "path": "C:/思源粗宋.ttf"}}], "text": "等一分钟就安装完成了"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 24], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "6807742980271641102", "path": "C:/思源粗宋.ttf"}}], "text": "然后你去连接器那儿打开一个信任按钮，把它信任启动"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 18], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "6807742980271641102", "path": "C:/思源粗宋.ttf"}}], "text": "这个时候就可以使用我们的绘本连接器了"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 36], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "6807742980271641102", "path": "C:/思源粗宋.ttf"}}], "text": "你去给 WorkBuddy 说，给我来两本最新的绘本，它就会下载两本下来"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 31], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "6807742980271641102", "path": "C:/思源粗宋.ttf"}}], "text": "稍等一下，它就会把资料素材都下下来，然后可以装成一个可读的页面"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 22], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "6807742980271641102", "path": "C:/思源粗宋.ttf"}}], "text": "那这是一个，你看这还有一个两个，就是可以阅读"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 42], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "6807742980271641102", "path": "C:/思源粗宋.ttf"}}], "text": "你还可以说你给我直接下载这个绘本视频，WorkBuddy 里就会把这个视频直接拉下来"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 23], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "6807742980271641102", "path": "C:/思源粗宋.ttf"}}], "text": "你可以下下来以后自己点击播放，也能阅读这个绘本"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 20], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "6807742980271641102", "path": "C:/思源粗宋.ttf"}}], "text": "非常方便，大家快快去使用，谢谢大家的支持"}
